<p>Sing it sister! And don’t we Alabama fans know and LOVE the fact we were triumphant over the snitches! The Alabama game Saturday in the end, was one of the most fun games ever, and believe it or not, a huge part of the pure joy was due to the deep despair of the first half. After the heart stopping start, victory became apparent making <em>Dixieland Delight</em> a family chorus, the cigar smoke in the stadium was so strong it stung the eyes bringing tears of joy and the chants of “Roll Tide” departing the stadium combined for the formula of sheer bliss.&nbsp;So, “This is ALABAMA FOOTBALL” as we have come to know it this year. As long as our team continues to bring the <em>good</em> in the second half, this plan is working.</p><p>&nbsp;For the contributing non-players, a big THANK YOU to everyone Saturday who during half-time of the Alabama tennessee game did their part initiating the <em>good </em>by changing it up…moved to a different chair or even room to watch the second half of the game…changed shirts, socks or lucky undies to bring forth a winning combination of clothing! <em>Especially </em>since those attending the game could not do this as easily without some serious stares or dismissal from the stadium altogether, we owe the home fans big time. No doubt the Tide prevailed in the second half of the game due to your efforts. The <em>football</em> gods have noted your dedication and will pass on the <em>good</em> kharma of your actions to the <em>parking place</em> gods, <em>traffic</em> gods and <em>hair</em> gods…wait…you didn’t know there were <em>hair</em> gods? What kind of heathens are you people? You never noticed how after you make fun of someone your hair looks <em>bad</em> the next day? You think it’s humidity that causes <em>good and bad hair</em> days…puh-lease.&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="266" width="190"></p><p>Self portrait of my hair the day after sending out last week’s football schedule asking everyone to hate on tennessee. Them’s the facts…it’s science, y’all.&nbsp;</p><p>I’m hoing 100% positive today in hopes of a better look this week. No need to belabor the volatiles being dirty and low down for punching Roydell Williams in the head while he was defenseless on the ground or Dabo’s weekly quotes going from bad to worse (skipping the good altogether) with last week’s jewel about needing to “lose a few games to lighten up the bandwagon (fans)” to this week making light of mental illness commenting on his team’s losses (<a href="https://www.thestate.com/sports/college/acc/clemson-university/article280841165.html" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://www.thestate.com/sports/college/acc/clemson-university/article280841165.html</a>)?! And I’m not going to even allude to the aubs 3-4 record which I am pretty sure Bryan Harson could have pulled off if he had been allowed to do so. But no need to go there. All is <em>good </em>at the Capstone as we relax for the bye week and prepare for our beloved Coach Saban’s 29<sup>th</sup> birthday.</p><p>Enjoy the off week, the GOAT’s bday, <em>good</em> <em>hair, parking and traffic</em> and Week 9! RTR!</p><p>&nbsp;Jackie</p>
